test_title: PYST 124: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 24 Jan, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: 6 people P, Q, R, S, T, and U are sitting on a wall facing North. P is to the immediate left of Q. R is to the immediate right of Q. Only S is sitting between R and T. U is sitting to the immediate right of T. Who is sitting between Q and S?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) P is to the immediate left of Q.

2) R is to the immediate right of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c1f7df3a9001b8a065bfecd8737893ac50b053ce653a527d59e16c3f55c4e0d.png] 

3) Only S is sitting between R and T.
